name: Moniker Smith's Bloodlines
source: A depraved visual novel in which an entire town is taken over by vampires who hunger for more than just blood. Follow branching plotlines as an ancient power awakens and a vampire infection spreads among the townspeople. This story focuses heavily on themes of corruption and transformation.
